facts.statement: Afghanistan and Iran signed the Helmand River Water Treaty on 13 March 1973.
facts.note: Search FAOLEX or the UN Treaty Collection for the 1973 Helmand River Water Treaty.

facts.statement: The 1973 treaty gives Iran an average flow of Helmand water.
facts.note: Not opened from the build session (official sites were not reachable); check it against the link.

facts.statement: Afghanistan agreed in the 1973 treaty to deliver a further flow to Iran as goodwill.

facts.statement: Afghanistan inaugurated the Kamal Khan Dam on the Helmand on 24 March 2021.
